# Fallback Content

`email/fallback-content` &middot; content-level &middot; category: email

## Purpose

One block for most clients and a simpler block for Outlook desktop, using conditional comments.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `primary` | components (content-level) |  |
| `fallback` | components (content-level) |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Primary for most clients, fallback for Outlook desktop.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |


## Responsive behavior

No dedicated responsive settings. It follows the width of the column or section it sits in.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Shows only the fallback slot. | Shows only the primary slot. | Nothing extra, the components inside carry their own colors. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('email/fallback-content', {
  "primary": [
    {
      "component": "decorative/badge",
      "data": {
        "text": "New arrivals"
      },
      "variant": "pill"
    },
    {
      "component": "content/text",
      "data": {
        "text": "Fresh linens, just in."
      }
    }
  ],
  "fallback": [
    {
      "component": "content/text",
      "data": {
        "text": "New arrivals: fresh linens, just in."
      }
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "email/fallback-content",
  "data": {
    "primary": [
      {
        "component": "decorative/badge",
        "data": {
          "text": "New arrivals"
        },
        "variant": "pill"
      },
      {
        "component": "content/text",
        "data": {
          "text": "Fresh linens, just in."
        }
      }
    ],
    "fallback": [
      {
        "component": "content/text",
        "data": {
          "text": "New arrivals: fresh linens, just in."
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
